tools.name: livestorm_get_organization
tools.description: Get the Livestorm organization (workspace) that the API token belongs to. Good first call to confirm which workspace is connected. Livestorm API: GET /organization (identity scope).

tools.name: livestorm_list_events
tools.description: List the events of the workspace, with title, status (draft, published, ...), scheduling status and timestamps. Filter by title, tag or created/updated dates. Livestorm API: GET /events.

tools.name: livestorm_get_event
tools.description: Get one event by id: title, slug, registration link, status, recording and chat settings. Livestorm API: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: livestorm_list_event_sessions
tools.description: List the sessions (single occurrences) of one event, with status and start time. Livestorm API: GET /events/{id}/sessions.

tools.name: livestorm_list_sessions
tools.description: List all sessions across the workspace, filtered by status and date range. Use it for upcoming or past sessions across all events. Livestorm API: GET /sessions.

tools.name: livestorm_get_session
tools.description: Get one session by id: start time, timezone, status, name and duration. Livestorm API: GET /sessions/{id}.

tools.name: livestorm_list_session_people
tools.description: List the registrants and attendees of one session, with role and attendance. Filter to attended people or to one email. Livestorm API: GET /sessions/{id}/people.

tools.name: livestorm_list_session_questions
tools.description: List the questions that attendees asked in one session. Livestorm API: GET /sessions/{id}/questions.

tools.name: livestorm_list_session_recordings
tools.description: List the recordings of one session. Each recording URL is signed and expires after url_expires_in seconds. Livestorm API: GET /sessions/{id}/recordings.

tools.name: livestorm_list_people
tools.description: List all people in the workspace who engaged with one of its events at some point, including team members. Filter by role or email. Livestorm API: GET /people.

tools.name: livestorm_get_person
tools.description: Get one person by id: name, email, role and custom attributes. Livestorm API: GET /people/{id}.

tools.name: livestorm_list_event_people
tools.description: List all people linked to any session of one event, with role. Filter by role or email. Livestorm API: GET /events/{id}/people.

tools.name: livestorm_list_people_attributes
tools.description: List the custom people attributes (registration fields) defined in the workspace. Livestorm API: GET /people_attributes.

tools.name: livestorm_list_team_members
tools.description: List the team members of the organization, including pending invitations. Needs the admin scope on the API token. Livestorm API: GET /users.

tools.name: livestorm_create_event
tools.description: Create one new event in the workspace (draft by default), or duplicate an existing one with copy_from_event_id. Creates one event per call. Livestorm API: POST /events.

tools.name: livestorm_create_event_session
tools.description: Create one new session for an existing event: start time, timezone and name. Creates one session per call. Livestorm API: POST /events/{id}/sessions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: livestorm_get_event, livestorm_list_session_people, livestorm_list_session_recordings, livestorm_list_people, livestorm_get_person, livestorm_list_event_people · Private data: livestorm_get_organization, livestorm_list_team_members · Public sink: livestorm_list_session_people, livestorm_list_people, livestorm_get_person, livestorm_list_event_people, livestorm_create_event, livestorm_create_event_session.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: livestorm_get_event, livestorm_list_session_people, livestorm_list_session_recordings, livestorm_list_people, livestorm_get_person, livestorm_list_event_people · Private data: livestorm_get_organization, livestorm_list_team_members · Public sink: livestorm_list_session_people, livestorm_list_people, livestorm_get_person, livestorm_list_event_people, livestorm_create_event, livestorm_create_event_session

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
